steps.name: Staff A
steps.text: Psst, hey. You saw Michael and Marion's bodies too, right?

steps.name: Staff B
steps.text: Dude! Don't remind me, I've been trying to forget! It was freaking terrifying!

spans.text: Dude! Don't remind me, I've been trying to

steps.name: Staff B
steps.text: M-My hands are still shaking so much, I don't think I can hold the boom mic...

steps.name: Staff A
steps.text: You're still worried about work?! When there's an actual serial killer on set right now?

steps.name: Staff B
steps.text: So... let's skedaddle?

steps.name: Staff A
steps.text: You want to run? Did you already forget how Michael and Marion ended up like that?

steps.name: Staff A
steps.text: Michael even had his suitcase right under him. I heard he'd been packed and ready to go for quite a while. Even found himself a secret passage to leave through...

steps.name: Staff A
steps.text: And he still was murdered right before he left the plate.

steps.name: Staff A
steps.text: No way that killer's gonna let any of us leave.

steps.name: Staff A
steps.text: It's just like the plot of Jack The Liberipper. This set is now his hunting ground, and any one of us could very well be his prey.

spans.text: It's just like the plot of
. This set is now his hunting ground, and any one of us could very well be his prey.

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Abner, how long has it been since you inspected your chest rig?

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Look, there's a bunch of loose screws on your mechanical arm. One little slip, and that camera's gonna be shards of glass all over the floor...

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: If it breaks, it breaks.

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: At least let me take a look at your camera lens then.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: I'm good.

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: I'm your assistant, you know.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: Don't think I don't see what you're actually up to—you best stay away from me, kiddo.

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Dalton's death was no accident, right? The same goes for Shelly, Michael, and Marion...

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: There's no way the victims were chosen at random. All of them were involved in that incident five years ago.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: You should be working for one of those gossip rags, not behind a camera.

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Who said they were mutually exclusive? Reporters make more dough though... Anyway, Abner, my good man, you were there five years ago, right? C'mon, you can tell me. Not like we'll be doing anything else today.

steps.name: Steven
steps.text: Miss Rutherford, you have no lines in this scene...

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Then do you suppose I could simply stay in my room researching which exact foundation shade Lady Dupont should be wearing before she dies?

steps.name: Steven
steps.text: That will be decided after we finish the climatic scenes at the end, which are still... I'm sorry...

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Ah, so that god of yours is running tardy. But I'm in no mood to blame your god right now, my dear.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Were we not so far from the city, a major incident like this would have the Wrankwood police locking down the plate and crawling all over our set. And naturally, the shooting would be suspended.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Not to say that our current situation is any better.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Steven, I'm starting to worry that my investment in this project will come to nothing.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: How much do you or Greta know about what's transpired these past few days, that I don't?

steps.name: Staff C
steps.text: Oh, this is where you two were.

steps.name: Staff C
steps.text: So where's the producer? Greta owes us an explanation!
Whispers abound.
Gossip permeates the set, with not a single soul at work.
Three homicides, and four victims. The spate of murders has everyone overcome with fear, anger, confusion, and shock... The whole film crew is on the verge of losing control.
The clamor sends even her own heart into a mess. She hates the feeling.
Greta struts right into the center of the studio, and switches on the brightest bulb. The piercing light stuns everyone into silence, and everyone's attention fixes on her.
She takes a deep breath.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I have some announcements to make, everyone.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I've never received any training as an actor, so you might have to come closer to hear me.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: You'll want to check your personal Wrankwood financial terminals in a few minutes. I've instructed finance to send out everyone's remaining wages.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Of course, the families of Dalton, Shelly, Michael, and Marion will also receive compensation for their losses, which I will handle personally later.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Yes, The Death of Lady Dupont has yet to conclude filming, and your contracts are still valid, so none of this should even be necessary. But I can count on one hand how many of you are still in the mood to work.

spans.text: has yet to conclude filming, and your contracts are still valid, so none of this should even be necessary. But I can count on one hand how many of you are still in the mood to work.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Hah, this is so unlike you, Greta.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: We've simply run into a few... considerable hiccups. But this is no time to thrown in the towel.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Or has this experience made our producer lose confidence in the quality of the film?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Throwing in the towel? You're overthinking it, darling.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I've never once doubted my own judgment, much less considered abandoning the project.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Then why are you—

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I'd like you to gather round for a story, everyone.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Hey, kid...

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Me, Miss Stone?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Take out your pen recorder, notebook, shorthand terminal, whatever... Then sit down, and listen.

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Wh-What do you mean?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I've seen you sneaking around with those toys, and I don't appreciate it. But feel free to record everything I'm about to say.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Take it to Trimounts Entertainment Weekly, or Wrankwood Coffee Time, or Persons Magazine... I don't care, as long as you get the story out. I won't hold you accountable either.

spans.text: ... I don't care, as long as you get the story out. I won't hold you accountable either.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: See it as a reward, or a punishment. It doesn't matter to me.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I take it everyone here is familiar with the Wrankwood Academy Awards.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: The Best Newcomer award. Every year, countless students of film and television schools, as well as amateur film buffs, submit their entries in a bid to prove how much they understand their creations and the market.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: They crave for their work to be chosen, because even the lowest award still implies their film is up to Wrankwood's standards... and a certain Phidia was no exception.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: She believed herself to be an auteur with both the brains and the will to realize her dreams. She was certain she would one day stand on Wrankwood's red carpet, even if she had to temporarily settle for life in a cramped rental.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: So she waited for the very best story and the very best partners, then she put together a crew and brought that story to life. Submitted it.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: But this no-name newcomer craved success too much, not to mention the pressure of living up to the expectations of her companions.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: As the voting period was ending, her obsession intensified, along with her doubts about the quality of the work she had submitted.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: She could not rationalize her strange thoughts. She begged both friends and family, and raised a large sum—large for her then, at least—before knocking on the judges' doors.

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Why does this sound so familiar...?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: On the very day of the Academy Awards, the committee publicized what the Phidia had done, and in so doing proved Wrankwood's professionalism and purity to the whole of Terra.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: And so she was disqualified. Her crew cut all ties with her, and she lost everything she had.

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Now I remember!

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: It was so ironic, because the academy later revealed that the work had actually won by votes anyway, the most recognized by the jury.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Afterward, she spent a decade exhausting every option to re-enter Wrankwood, and slowly made some achievements of her own.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Of course, she changed her name as well... to Greta Stone.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: So, Melanie. Now you know what an absolute fool I am.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I went out of my way to provoke fate into playing a joke on me.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Fortunately, that preposterous experience has taught me one thing: I should never doubt myself.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I will always believe in my own judgment, and never give up on anything I attempt.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Haha, you're more of a character than I took you for.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Though truth be told, I always thought that infallible persona of yours was just a front to intimidate others.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: Come on, Greta.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: So what's the sudden backstory for... You trying to win our sympathy?

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: Dead people in here and a Catastrophe out there... You think we'd still want to put our lives on the line, just for you? After all that's happened?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I know you still hold it against me, Abner.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: ...Ever since five years ago.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: How could I? I mean, I was awarded Best Cinematography that year thanks to those classic shots from that film...

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: It's the highest honor any cinematographer could ever dream of... and you gave it to me!

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: But what about after that?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: You hit the peak of your career, then fell into despair. In just six months no one dared put you behind their cameras.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: You used to love your cameras so much, but now you treat them like empty potato chip bags.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Before you joined the crew for The Death of Lady Dupont, you even lost your decades-old partner at the casino, yes?

spans.text: Before you joined the crew for
, you even lost your decades-old partner at the casino, yes?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: You hate that film from five years ago, you hate the shot that won you the award, and you hate me for making you keep it—

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: You bet I do!

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: My camera captured that Laura girl's fall, and when I saw how you reacted, I knew then and there that you had zero good intentions.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: I warned you again and again, but you insisted on keeping that shot in the final cut...

spans.text: I warned you again and again, but you
on keeping that shot in the final cut...

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: The more I think back to how the jury commented on the shot's realism and shock value, the more I want to laugh!

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: Film is the art of creating dreams. Cameras are the eyes that see dreams, and the hands that turn fantasy into reality. But you insulted that girl's memory. You insulted me!

spans.text: Film is the art of creating dreams. Cameras are the eyes that see dreams, and the hands that turn fantasy into reality. But you insulted that girl's memory. You insulted

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: Now I hate this damn thing I'm holding, and I hate my work! You get it now?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: If you really think so, then put it down, Abner.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I'm sorry, we've derailed. Now to get back on topic—

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: After confirming you've received your compensation, any of you may leave this production at any time.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Would you rather flee this dangerous plate? By all means. Scared of the serial killer, and wish to find somewhere to hide? Go ahead.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Feel like playing detective for whatever reason? Knock yourself out. Even if you're the murderer yourself, and unwilling to give up on your vengeance, you have my blessing.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: We've already filmed most of The Death of Lady Dupont, with only a few climactic scenes to cover in the last two days of our schedule.

spans.text: , with only a few climactic scenes to cover in the last two days of our schedule.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Who knows, maybe we can even finish it with those willing to stay.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: As for who will work the camera... I will take Abner's place myself.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Melanie?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: You do realize I can hardly find a last minute stand-in for Lady Dupont herself, yes?

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: You know I don't have a choice.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: I'm still counting on this film to beat Marianne.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Even a Catastrophe cloud can have a silver lining.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Marianne retired from cinema years ago. I've never understood why you're so obsessed with her.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: That's none of your business.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: But let me be frank: you won't get to demand special treatment as the female lead or insist on those 'rules of the film set' you love so much, once everyone else has evacuated.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Haha.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Steven.

steps.name: Steven
steps.text: I know, I know! I'll fix the ending by tonight!

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I believe in my decision to invest in this story, darling, and I believe you've collected enough inspiration over the past few days.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Catastrophe draws near, and death is right before our eyes... Surely your god loves material like that?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Alright, thank you for your time, people, and I wish you well on your future endeavors.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: That's all from me.
